result_text:
I removed the cap from both places that applied `contributorsListLimit` to contributor lists. The reports module compiles and its tests pass (`mvn -q -o -pl reports test` finished with no output, which in quiet mode means no failures).

- **`reports/.../landscape/statichtml/LandscapeContributorsReport.java`**: `saveContributorsTable` no longer reads the limit or calls `.limit(...)`, so every contributor gets a row in `contributors.html`, `contributors-recent.html`, and the bots and teams pages. I also removed the "The list is limited to N items (out of M)." note. The sort order is unchanged.
- **`reports/.../landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportContributorsTab.java`**: the "contributors sorted by recent commits" bar chart now iterates over all recently active contributors instead of the first N, so it has one bar per contributor.

I left `contributorsListLimit` in `LandscapeConfiguration` so existing configs still load, and it is now unused by these two reports. I also left the hard-coded `listLimit = 500` in `ContributorsReportGenerator`, because it belongs to the per-repository contributors report, not the landscape report. Nothing is committed.
